description: Single radial chart composed entirely of stacked annular arc segments. Numerous narrow angular sectors form a ring around the center; within each sector, multiple colored arc segments are stacked radially from an inner radius to the outer boundary, creating radial bar heights that vary by angle. Concentric guide circles, labels, and legend inside the hole are ignored.

primary.explanation: Around the circle, many angular sectors (states) are evenly distributed.

secondary.explanation: Within each sector, seven age groups are stacked radially.
